# NCT06594991 
 
Status: RECRUITING | Phase: PHASE2 | Study Type: INTERVENTIONAL | Sponsor: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center 
 
Title: A Study of Fianlimab, Cemiplimab, and Ipilimumab in People With Melanoma 
Target Enrollment: 88 
Eligible Ages: 18 Years to Any age 
Start Date: 2024-09-10 | Completion Date: 2027-09 
Source: ClinicalTrials.gov 
 
## Conditions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- Advanced Melanoma 
 
## Interventions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- Fianlimab *(DRUG)* 
- Cemiplimab *(DRUG)* 
- Ipilimumab *(DRUG)* 
 
## Summary (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
 
The purpose of this study is to test whether the combination of fianlimab, cemiplimab, and ipilimumab is a safe and effective treatment that causes few or mild side effects for locally advanced or metastatic, unresectable, refractory melanoma.
